name: Eurodollar EURY
oneLiner: EURY is Eurodollar ApS’s euro token on Ethereum, with a legal right to par redemption and safeguarded reserve assets.
collateral: Issuer-described one-for-one euro reserve assets held in safeguarded accounts; current asset weights, banks, custodians and independent reconciliations are unpublished.
pegMechanism: A euro-denominated claim on Eurodollar ApS, redeemable at par after identity and bank-account checks; client reserve assets are described as segregated from issuer assets.
launchPhaseDetail: Public on-chain issuance is verified from July 23, 2026. The issuer says EURY is in circulation; no admitted price lane is available.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: exact-contract CoinGecko and DefiLlama quotes and DexScreener pools were unavailable on review. Positive Ethereum issuance is verified.

proofOfReserves.provider: Eurodollar ApS / issuer-published Olbra brand reserve policy; reserve reports and third-party attestations are not published

milestones.title: EURY issuance is recorded on Ethereum
milestones.description: An observed mint creates 5,000 EURY on the issuer-linked Ethereum deployment. The issuer separately confirms that EURY is in public issue.
